title: Etale multiplicative degree-two cohomology equals Galois cohomology
statement: For every field K, H²_G(Ks^×) [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] is in bijection with H²(Spec(K)_et,G_m), the cohomological Brauer group [def-br].

proof.text: Use the adopted source construction gmSheafFiberGaloisPointAddEquiv: transport the evaluation equivalence at the algebraic closure to the Galois point using galoisPointSheafFiberIso. Evaluation on germs identifies the stalk with separable-closure units. Naturality of evaluation under field automorphisms, as proved in gmSheafFiberGaloisPointAddEquiv_presheafFiberAct, gives equivariance.

Specialize the existing additive stalk cohomology comparison sheafHAddEquivContinuousCohomology at Ks = SeparableClosure K, F = gmSheaf, M = galoisUnitsTopRep K, and n = 2. The discrete topology instance is supplied by rfl, and the preceding stalk equivalence and equivariance supply its two arguments. This is exactly the body of the attached source construction cohomologicalBrauerGroupAddEquivGaloisUnitsH2.

The inverse additive equivalence, with additivity forgotten, is a bijection from Field.GaloisUnitsH2 K to the cohomological Brauer group. Thus the source construction proves the unchanged node statement; the old Sheaf theorem and the inhomogeneous-cocycle detour are redundant.
